sample: season 2025: 271 games, 18 weeks; ladders 411; props ladders 191

stop_conditions_and_caps.winners: stop and record a negative result if the model weight's wild-bootstrap p-value is 0.05 or more and equivalence is shown; cap 8 variants
stop_conditions_and_caps.spreads_totals: stop if the model is worse than the ladder with an interval excluding 0; cap 3 margin and 2 total variants
stop_conditions_and_caps.props: stop if fewer than 10 week clusters or the market ladder beats every arm; cap 5 arms
stop_conditions_and_caps.point_in_time: stop the chain if a planted 24 hour leak is not detected; no new tests
